issue.body:
Two round75 clay reviews have a minor operational wording error in `evidence[evidence_id=batch].locator`: “all three command exits” should read “all four command exits”. Both original checks lists already enumerate all four successful commands.

Affected reviews: `20261014T155141Z-vermiculite-round75-independent` and `20261014T155141Z-montmorillonite-round75-independent`. Scientific claims, owner hashes, review verdicts and empty finding sets are unchanged.

Append-only correction: `reviews/publication/20261014-round75/20261014T155418Z-review-locator-correction.json` and `reviews/publication/20261014-round75/20261014T155418Z-review-locator-correction.md`. These bind both original YAML/Markdown hashes and the actual terminal receipt/log hashes. Acceptance: preserve original bundles, verify all four actual command exits, and retain this correction in the PR. No redundant scientific review or history event is needed.
issue.title: Correct round75 clay review command-count locator without rewriting saved reviews
